name: Ferrogate Prison Transport
description: An armored ground vehicle designed for transporting detained persons between security facilities. Windowless rear compartment, individual restraint stations, signal jamming, and enough armor to survive an ambush. The Prison Transport is the last vehicle many detainees see before they enter a corporate detention facility. It's also the vehicle most likely to be targeted by freelancers running extraction jobs — getting someone out of a Transport before it reaches the facility is a staple of the mercenary trade.
autonomy: Human driver with AI route optimization (anti-ambush routing)
armament: Interior restraint systems, exterior deterrent (classified), escort drone capability.
common_usage: Detainee transport, high-value prisoner movement, bait vehicle for ambush operations.
story_hooks: A Prison Transport is ambushed and the freelancers discover one of the 'detainees' was planted — the whole thing is a trap
A Transport arrives at a facility with the correct number of detainees but different people than the manifest lists — someone swapped prisoners mid-route
physical_description: A hulking, boxy transport vehicle with welded steel plating and reinforced composite panels, painted institutional grey-black with faded Ferrogate Transit markings. The cabin sits forward and elevated, separated from the sealed rear compartment by a reinforced bulkhead, with no windows save for the driver's narrow, mesh-protected viewport. Rust blooms around the seams where rain-slicked metal meets worn rubber, and the entire frame bears the dents and scorches of prior extraction attempts.
